title: Sign-up to live site with no human step (staging)
description:
What: payment, account creation, entitlement, tenant provisioning and first sign-in chained; payment is required before the site exists.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A paid sign-up reaches a live site
  Given a new person completes payment in staging
  When provisioning finishes
  Then their subdomain serves a starter site and they can sign in as admin

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reached at milestone M7 (PPY-dad077) through PPY-70a429, PPY-3aa10f, PPY-810f42 and the Prospectus changes from PPY-6d9a6d.
